prompt: Some people get into debts by buying things they don't need and can't afford. What are the reasons for this behavior? What action can be taken to prevent people from having this problem?
essay:
This essay will give the reasons why some people enjoy buying things that may not be vital for their needs , and the waste of money and time in ordering non-beneficial items. From my point of view,  such habits need to change to be more practical, effective and useful.

On the one hand, there are several reasons behind this attitude.  Firstly; online shopping, which makes everything easy to buy and sometimes gives the opportunity to pay later, and without going to the market , you can order your preferred items. Second; time saving for shopping is significant online versus shopping in markets. Third; a psychological part, for example, individuals feel positive when buying a new item. Those encouraging feelings are mandatory to succeed in life.

However, on the other hand, Governments should take some action to prevent people from having  such habits. For example, awareness programs related to the paradigm of online shopping. This module will give an example of how people should ask themselves  what and what is required to buy. Second educational program at schools for parents as well as for students to explain the disadvantages of these behaviours and the massive impact that can be avoided. Prioritising the needs by making a list each month will focus on the essential needs and provide the right indication about the shortage areas to improve.

In conclusion, it’s important to see that the government has raised  public awareness about buying un-necessity list or collections that are not useful in the long term. While it’s also a fact that these behaviours will remain and cannot be eliminated.
